bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -d "$root" || exit 60
echo GAYBBS_PARENT_PRESENT=YES
test "$(git -C "$root" remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#^git@github.com:#https://github.com/#')" = "https://github.com/seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot.git" || exit 61
echo SOURCE_PARENT_SHA="$(git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD)"
if [ -s "$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_recipient.txt" ]; then echo REPORT_RECIPIENT_SECRET=PRESENT; else echo REPORT_RECIPIENT_SECRET=MISSING; fi
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_STATE="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_ENABLED="$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
echo GAYBBS_CONTAINERS_BEGIN
docker ps --filter name=gaybbs --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}'
echo GAYBBS_CONTAINERS_END
echo LOCAL_IMAGE_ID="$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)"
echo CANDIDATE_IMAGE_ID="$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bug-autoack-5bac2a0 --format '{{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)"
